title: Playing again with the Brunies boys in 1952
summary: They played together again in 1952, weekly dances, and the interviewer mentions seeing them with Jules Gallo.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. No, not David was. He was playing Back Bay High School with Mary Brunas, Abby Brunas, who was the other bunch of that band in 19... Jules, I guess. No. That was in 1952. We were playing there in 1952. We were playing together again. The Brunas was.

I remember that. Oh, we used to pull apart and go back together and pull apart. I heard about that. Yeah. We had a dance every Saturday night when we were back in high school. Yeah, but that was the standard gate. Every Saturday night.

When I saw them, they were at Baracell. Do you know where Baracell is? Right on the... It's on the beach, huh? On the beach, yeah. They were there for a while. But they had a different clarinet where they had this Jules Gallo.
Yeah, Jules. Jules Gallo. I don't know if that's why I wanted you up.
